product_family: Fitbit wearable fitness trackers and health monitoring devices, including consumer Fitbit app (now Google Health) and enterprise Fitbit Wellness platform with HIPAA support.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification for Fitbit consumer app or Google Health. Google Cloud and Google Workspace hold SOC 2, but these do not apply to consumer Fitbit.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No ISO 27001 mentioned in Fitbit privacy policy or security documentation for consumer app. Google Cloud and Google Workspace hold ISO 27001, but these do not apply to consumer Fitbit.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable to consumer Fitbit; applies only to Google Cloud services.

certifications.name: HIPAA (with BAA)
certifications.proof_quote: Fitbit Wellness will be able to expand integration opportunities with health plans and self-insured employers by its ability to enter into Business Associate Agreements with HIPAA-covered entities. Note: this applies only to the enterprise Fitbit Wellness offering; the consumer Fitbit app is not HIPAA covered.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: While Fitbit claims GDPR compliance, three GDPR complaints were filed by noyb (Max Schrems' organization) in August 2023 in Austria, Netherlands, and Italy alleging illegal data transfers to the US without adequate legal mechanism and forced consent without meaningful withdrawal option.

certifications.name: Data Privacy Framework (EU-US, Swiss-US)
certifications.proof_quote: Fitbit LLC complies with the EU-U.S. and Swiss-U.S. Data Privacy Frameworks (DPF) and the UK Extension to the EU-U.S. DPF as set forth by the US Department of Commerce.

certifications.name: PSTI (UK Product Security and Telecommunications Infrastructure)
certifications.proof_quote: the Products are in conformance with the applicable security requirements in Schedule 1 of The Product Security and Telecommunications Infrastructure (Security Requirements for Relevant Connectable Products) Regulations 2023.

certifications.name: AU Cyber Security Rules
certifications.proof_quote: Google declares that Fitbit Air has been manufactured in compliance with the Cyber Security (Security Standards for Smart Devices) Rules 2025.

privacy.ai_training_note: Fitbit does NOT automatically use customer health data for AI model training. Users must explicitly opt in to participate in research and development programs where their data can be used to train Google's generative models. Conversation data from Google Health Coach may undergo human review if user provides feedback.
privacy.data_region: United States and other countries (no specific data center locations disclosed)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Transport Layer Security (TLS) encryption used for data transmission between devices and servers

security.name: Payment Data Security
security.value: Card details encrypted and tokenized; tokens sent back to device instead of storing raw payment information

security.name: Security Controls
security.value: Combination of technical, administrative, and physical controls to maintain data security

security.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
security.value: Two-factor authentication available for account security

security.name: Security Updates
security.value: Fitbit devices receive security updates for at least 2 years after the applicable device is last sold

security.name: Account Monitoring
security.value: Users can view which devices are logged into accounts and revoke access to unrecognized devices

products.name: Fitbit Fitness Trackers (Consumer Wearables)
products.data_scope: Steps, heart rate, sleep data, location, food/weight logs, female health tracking. NOT HIPAA compliant.
products.notes: Personal health data not used for Google Ads. Data transfers to US and other countries. Opt-in for research use only.

products.name: Fitbit Wellness (Enterprise)
products.data_scope: Same as consumer Fitbit, but with HIPAA-compliant controls and BAA support
products.notes: Only variant with HIPAA BAA. Designed for corporate wellness programs, health plans, and self-insured employers. Covers basic fitness metrics only in HIPAA mode.

products.name: Google Health (formerly Fitbit App)
products.data_scope: Consolidated health tracking app integrating Fitbit data with Google Health features
products.notes: Replaces standalone Fitbit app. Not HIPAA compliant. Supports opt-in research participation.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free consumer app; premium features; enterprise wellness contracts)

flags: CRITICAL: Three GDPR complaints filed August 2023 by noyb alleging illegal data transfers to US and forced consent. Potential fines up to €11.28 billion if found guilty.

CRITICAL: Consumer Fitbit is not HIPAA compliant. Only the enterprise Fitbit Wellness platform offers HIPAA support with a BAA. Marketing that suggests the consumer app is HIPAA-compliant would be an over-claim.
HIGH: No SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certifications for consumer Fitbit app, despite being owned by Google which holds these for Cloud/Workspace.
MODERATE: Limited GDPR consent withdrawal - users must delete entire accounts to opt out of data transfers, losing all health data. GDPR requires withdrawal without account deletion.
MODERATE: Data transfers to US lack clear legal mechanism post-Schrems II ruling. Reliance on Data Privacy Framework is disputed by privacy advocates.
MODERATE: 2021 data leak by third-party GetHealth exposed 61M fitness records including Fitbit data (unsecured database with names, birthdates, weight, health data).
LOW: Account takeover risk if 2FA not enabled; security updates only guaranteed for 2 years.
